# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-279#observe-stale-reclaimer-handoff

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-279-observe-stale-reclaimer-handoff.md#observe-stale-reclaimer-handoff` at `568afed10f4bd573446c6f651b49047547525ba4`, with plan 544.
- **Selected promise:** After both contenders have observed the original owner, the loser must remain excluded by the live successor. An original-owner observation cannot satisfy the successor observation.
- **One fault:** In `scripts/local-test-suite.mjs`, inside the changed live blocking-owner branch, inserted `if (reportedOwner !== undefined) return async () => {};`. This lets a previously blocked contender return from admission and start checks when it encounters the successor, instead of remaining blocked. No fixture or assertion changed.
- **Existing fixture and observation:** `fixture()` / `controlledSuites()` materialize the real runner and admission module through MakeMe. The failure case in `tests/support/local-test-suite-lifecycle.test.mjs` first asserts both `.gate` values equal the original owner, then holds the first successor and awaits `losing.blockedBy(successor)` at line 67. Its shared observer rejects when a check starts before that exact-owner observation (`tests/support/local-test-suite-gates.mjs:31`).
- **Command, unchanged across all three runs:** `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i npm test -- tests/support/local-test-suite-lifecycle.test.mjs`.
- **Baseline:** Whole lifecycle file passed, exit 0, including the selected controlled failure case.
- **Fault reach and result:** Exit 1. The selected failure case rejected with `Error: 1 checks started before the admission gate` at the existing observer assertion. The controlled setup had already observed both original-owner gates, so the subsequent started check demonstrates bypass on the successor path. SIGTERM and SIGINT variations also rejected at that assertion; no unrelated failure was reported.
- **Restoration:** Restored the admission module byte-for-byte from its original backup, verified clean tracked, index and untracked Git state at the same revision, then reran the identical whole lifecycle command: exit 0. No temporary code change remains.
- **Isolation and evidence:** Created scratch worktree `/tmp/open-dough-seed279-intent-20261109` and branch `codex/intent-seed279-20261109` at the selected revision. Scratch-local locked npm, browser and native check stages passed; proof ran awake on AC under the maintained sleep guard. Removed the clean owned scratch worktree and branch after restoration. The execution checkout was untouched. Logs remain at `/tmp/seed279-intent-baseline.log`, `/tmp/seed279-intent-fault.log`, `/tmp/seed279-intent-restored.log`; terminal results and restoration state are in `/tmp/seed279-intent-results.json`.

- **Test runtime:** Restored lifecycle run: 6.7 seconds (measured by the maintained runner in `/tmp/seed279-intent-times.txt`). Baseline and fault runtimes are unavailable because their shared timing file was replaced by the restored run; no timing rerun was performed.
- **Human effort:** Unavailable; no separate human effort measurement was recorded.
